title: Grandleon Damage Stat Cap
notes: Every number the damage arithmetic reads stops at 16383, and this project writes one past it in each of the seven places one can be written: a class's strength, defense, resistance and magic, and a weapon's, a cast's and an item's power. The bound is not a taste. A blow is max(1, strength + power - defense) computed wide and narrowed back to the int16 health is kept in, so a strength of twenty thousand carrying a power of twenty thousand narrows to a negative and being hit heals the target. The engine refuses such a unit at both gates that build an encounter, which means a compiler that admitted these would hand an author a package the game turns away with board_rejected. All seven are refused here instead, while the author can still see the file. The four stats beside them that are only checked non-negative — skill, luck and evasion — are percentage points on a hit chance the rules clamp before reading, and they keep the whole of what an int16 holds; a project pinning that is richer-stat-line.json.
